name: POTASSIUM CHLORIDE 500 MG 50 TABLETS
description: Potassium chloride 500 mg, in a 50-tablet presentation, marketed under the brand name Kaliolite, is an electrolyte supplement used to prevent and treat potassium deficiency (hypokalemia). Potassium deficiency can occur for various reasons, such as the use of certain diuretics, vomiting, and diarrhea. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
